name: baaton
description: Baaton for coding agents: read tickets, move them through statuses, post comments and TLDRs on baaton.dev through its API.

interface.shortDescription: Tickets, statuses and work summaries on your Baaton board
interface.longDescription: Work from your Baaton board without leaving Codex: find the ticket to pick up, move it to In Progress, comment while you work, post a TLDR of what changed and hand it over for review. Uses a Baaton API key (BAATON_API_KEY).
defaultPrompt: Use Baaton to show the open tickets of my project, highest priority first.
Use Baaton to move the ticket I just finished to In Review with a TLDR of the changes.
